subject: AWS Private Offer — requested rev-share carveout and payment term exception
messages:
From: Elaine Wong <elaine@cloudscale.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Lee <kevin.legal@cloudscale.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private Offer request — CloudScale Retail

Hi Michael / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — CloudScale Retail is keen to move to a private offer on AWS. High level: 2-year commitment, estimated first-year spend ~$1.2M ARR (annualized), start-of-contract billing.

Their procurement asks for two non-standard items we want to flag early:
- 25% reseller revenue share to CloudScale (they're the channel partner operating the listing)
- Net 60 invoice terms to CloudScale (they will pay Redwood on net60 from invoice date)

I attached the latest quote for reference. Sara from AWS is copied to confirm the private offer flow and any marketplace constraints. Kevin (legal) is on the thread for contract redlines.

Can you confirm feasibility on your end? CloudScale would like to get to a signed offer by May 6 to align with their procurement cycle.

Thanks,
Elaine
Elaine Wong
Head of Partnerships, CloudScale Retail
elaine@cloudscale.com

Attachments: 20270425_CloudScale_Quote_v3.pdf

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Wong <elaine@cloudscale.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Jenkins <sara.aws@amazon.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer request — CloudScale Retail

Elaine — thanks for the clarity and the timeline.

Quick internal notes for transparency: the asks (25% rev-share + net60) are out of our standard marketplace playbook. Monica, can you run the rev-share model and call out ROI at 25% vs our standard 12-15%? Naomi — finance, please flag any payment-term constraints.

Sara / AWS — can you confirm any restrictions on net60 or marketplace settlement timing that would block this flow?

We want to move fast but need an approval path. I will compile a short exec memo if internal signoff is required.

-Michael
Michael Grant
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Wong <elaine@cloudscale.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer request — CloudScale Retail

Michael / Naomi — ran the model attached (revshare_model_CLRS_v2.xlsx). Short take: a straight 25% rev-share to CloudScale materially reduces our take rate — at $1.2M ARR it pushes gross margins below our acceptable threshold unless we increase list price or tighten discounts. Options to make this work without increasing long-term cost: 
- Approve 20% rev-share for year 1, step down to 12% year 2
- Keep rev-share at 15% but increase list price by ~7.5% (customer facing)
- Keep 25% but require 50% payment up-front at signing, remainder net60 (partial prepayment)

I attached the model and a suggested quote revision. Monica

Attachments: revshare_model_CLRS_v2.xlsx

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Lee <kevin.legal@cloudscale.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer request — CloudScale Retail

Folks — finance view: we can't accept net60 as a default for deals >$500k ARR without treasury signoff. Net60 increases DSO and creates revenue recognition complexity for marketplace settlements. We can consider net45 with accelerated settlement to Redwood (AWS pays vendor monthly) but we need a guarantee on timing.

If leadership approves a rev-share >20% or net60 we need an exec exception and a short memo citing commercial rationale and mitigations (escrow, partial prepayment, or price uplift). Legal — Kevin, please review the clause set Elaine mentioned and share redlines.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Kevin Lee <kevin.legal@cloudscale.com>, Sara Jenkins <sara.aws@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request: CloudScale AWS private offer — revenue share / payment-term exceptions needed by May 6

Vivek / Rishi — asking for rapid exec signoff so we can close CloudScale Retail. Summary:
- Deal: 2-year private offer, est. $1.2M ARR first-year spend via AWS private offer (see HubSpot HS-CLSR-0427)
- External asks: 25% rev-share to CloudScale, net60 invoice terms to them
- Internal risk: finance flags net60 for this $ size; 25% rev-share erodes margin substantially

Recommended compromise to close and protect margins:
1) Approve a one-time rev-share cap of 20% for year 1, stepping to 12% in year 2.
2) Approve net45 payment terms to CloudScale with requirement: 30% prepayment at signing (or we request AWS accelerated settlement).
3) Increase list price by 7.5% to preserve recognized revenue target (customer ok to discuss).

If you approve, legal will sign the redline and Sara/AWS will create the private offer on their side. The timeline is tight — CloudScale needs signed terms by May 6 to meet their fiscal cutover.

Please reply with Approve / Reject / Need changes.

Thanks,
Michael
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: CloudScale_Redline_20270426.docx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Kevin Lee <kevin.legal@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sara Jenkins <sara.aws@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: CloudScale AWS private offer — revenue share / payment-term exceptions needed by May 6

Michael — after reviewing finance and Monica's model, I approve an exception with conditions:
- Rev-share capped at 20% for Year 1, 12% Year 2. No higher rates.
- Net45 payment terms only. 30% prepayment required at signing (or proof of accelerated settlement from AWS).
- Total first-year Redwood net revenue capped to ensure minimum recognized of $700k — if thresholds miss, we reserve right to clawback marketing credits.
- Legal to finalize redline (Kevin) — no unusual indemnities or open-ended liabilities.

Please proceed to capture these conditions in the DocuSign bundle and coordinate with Sara to get the private offer template set up. Mark the HubSpot deal as executive-exception-approved.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
